labeling_method: In-session LLM labeling by the assistant model (glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI). Each candidate was labeled from the real source code in dataset/codeql_databases/path_traversal_dbs/streamlit_vuln (read-only); no external LLM API calls were made, no CodeQL queries were executed, and no PyVul ground truth, patch diffs, or CVE advisories were consulted.
framework_reference_note: No references/<framework>.md matches the detected framework Tornado in Augur 0.3.0; per WORKFLOW 4.2.3 source/sink shapes come from repository evidence (exploration/detection.json).

batches.scope: HTTP request-boundary source candidates (tornado request object reads, get_argument, handler route params, multipart fields) - sources.csv data rows 7-20, 22-24

Passed as body= to tornado.httputil.parse_body_arguments, which produces the args/files dicts that feed sessionId/widgetId and the multipart file fields. Genuine network input boundary; pass-1 note: the parsed upload data stays in memory (UploadedFile extends io.BytesIO), so no in-repo path sink is reached, but the boundary itself is real and feeds the src-019/src-020/src-022 family.

The value is percent-decoded (unquote_plus) and passed through generate_download_filename_from_title/string_util.clean_filename (which strips everything outside [-\w.] and rejects '.', '..') before being placed in the Content-Disposition response header. Real request boundary, but the only consumer is a response header and the cleaner is a genuine barrier on that flow; no filesystem path is involved. Kept as candidate for manual review.

original_candidate.context: ComponentRequestHandler.get: '/component/(.*)' route capture; parts[0] selects a registered component, '/'.join(parts[1:]) becomes filename, joined via os.path.join(component_root, filename) (components.py:319-320) then open(abspath, 'rb') (components.py:325) - no containment check observed

entries.rationale: The 'path' parameter of ComponentRequestHandler.get is the decoded tornado route capture from `/component/(.*)` (registered at server.py:391-395). parts[0] selects a registered component; '/'.join(parts[1:]) becomes filename and is joined with os.path.join(component_root, filename) (components.py:319-320) and opened (components.py:325) with no containment check, no basename/normpath, and no allowlist. Raw '../' segments are captured directly by the (.*) regex, percent-encoded '%2e%2e%2f' additionally decode (tornado unquotes regex captures), and a filename beginning with '/' or a drive letter makes os.path.join return an absolute path. Input controllability: everything after the component name, i.e. arbitrary relative traversal depth and absolute-path forms. This is the only complete in-repo untrusted-source-to-file-open flow (pairs with sink-009).

original_candidate.context: Tornado StaticFileHandler response hook: parameter is the request path (response header selection)

Genuine untrusted input that reaches a (framework-side) file-serving sink; the abspath/realpath root containment performed by tornado is the real barrier and cannot be verified in-repo.
